title: Pixel counter
description: Create an offline pixel-style counter with initial integer 0, button IDs increase/decrease/reset, and an output element ID count showing only the integer. Click adds one, subtracts one, or resets to zero. Support negative numbers. Include labeled keyboard-accessible buttons and README. Use HTML/CSS/JS only, no dependencies or storage. Keep total source under 200 lines.
limitations: Native keyboard behavior and pixel appearance require separate review.

title: Pixel task list
description: Create an offline pixel-style task list. Input ID todo-input, add button ID todo-add. Show integer-only total task count in #todo-total and incomplete task count in #remaining, both initially 0. First task gets text span #todo-text-1, checkbox #todo-check-1, and delete button #todo-delete-1. Adding trims text; blank input adds nothing. Toggling checkbox updates incomplete count; deleting removes task and updates both counts. New tasks get increasing numeric IDs. Keep all state in memory, no storage. Include labels and README. HTML/CSS/JS only, under 240 source lines.
limitations: In-memory list only; native keyboard activation, layout and accessibility need separate review.

title: Pixel calculator
description: Create a pixel-style two-number calculator. Inputs IDs left/right; select ID operation with values add/subtract/multiply/divide; button ID calculate; output ID result initially 0. Output only the numeric result, no label in the output. Reject empty/non-finite numbers and division by zero with exact text Error. Support negative inputs. Labels and README required. Offline HTML/CSS/JS, no packages/storage, under 200 lines.
limitations: Subtraction, multiplication, rounding, native keyboard and visual appearance not covered by these checks.

title: Pixel temperature converter
description: Create a pixel-style temperature converter. Text input ID temperature, select ID direction values c-to-f/f-to-c, button ID convert, output ID result initially --. Convert C to F with x*9/5+32, F to C with (x-32)*5/9. Output numeric value with exactly two decimals, without units. Empty or invalid/non-finite input produces exact Error. Include labels, formulas and README. Offline HTML/CSS/JS only, no storage/packages, under 200 lines.
limitations: Only listed numeric boundaries checked; native keyboard and visual appearance need separate review.

title: Pixel arithmetic quiz
description: Create an offline pixel-style two-question quiz. #question initially has exact text 2 + 2 = ?. Buttons #answer-a/#answer-b display 4/5 for first question. Clicking one answer locks answers and increments integer-only #score once if correct; score initially 0. #next advances to second question exact 3 + 3 = ?, answer-a is 5 and answer-b is 6. After answering second, #next sets #question to Finished. #restart resets first question and score. Include labels and README. HTML/CSS/JS only, no storage/packages, under 230 lines.
limitations: Second correct answer path, skipping questions, native keyboard and visual appearance need separate review.
